description: Climate readings from microclimate sensors deployed across the City of Melbourne, updated approximately every 15 minutes. Measures ambient air temperature (°C), relative humidity (%), atmospheric pressure (hPa), wind speed (m/s) and direction (degrees), particulate matter (PM2.5, PM10 in µg/m³), and ambient noise (dBA). Missing or unmeasured parameters are strictly preserved as null without zero-filling. Current sensor location and device evidence are derived directly from the active telemetry stream, rejecting deprecated historical sensor location tables as active device inventory.

admission_evidence.completeness_rule: All filtered OpenDataSoft pages match total_count for the requested time window
missing_requirements: Verified upstream license terms and production quota approval

invariants.no_historical_inventory_rule: Deprecated historical microclimate-sensor-locations table is never used as current equipment inventory; current device presence and coordinates are sourced solely from active telemetry readings.
invariants.no_zero_filling_rule: Missing measurements (null airtemperature, humidity, pressure, wind, pm25, pm10, noise) indicate unobserved or failed metrics and must strictly remain null, NEVER filled with zero (0).
invariants.unit_preservation_rule: Preserves explicit measurement units: airtemperature in °C, relativehumidity in %, atmosphericpressure in hPa, wind speeds in m/s, wind directions in degrees, pm25 and pm10 in µg/m³, and noise in dBA.
invariants.location_evidence_rule: Device coordinates from latlong are preserved as WGS84 point geometry; missing or invalid coordinates are quarantined with null geometry and centroid without fabricating (0,0).
